Compute an area-weighted CV from a BD Forêt v2 coverage

Source: R/cv_typology.R
cv_from_bdforet.Rd

For each polygon in bdforet_sf, look up the generic forest context (via bdforet_v2_mapping) and read the CV at the requested position. The final CV is the arithmetic mean of the per-polygon CVs, weighted by the polygon area (intersected with aoi when provided). Polygons mapped to NA (non-forest, coupe rase, lande) are dropped.

Usage

cv_from_bdforet(
  bdforet_sf,
  position = c("mid", "low", "high"),
  aoi = NULL,
  tfv_col = "TFV",
  mapping = NULL,
  typology = NULL
)

Arguments

bdforet_sf

sf. Polygons from BD Forêt v2 with a TFV code column (see tfv_col).

position

Character. CV bound to read ("mid", "low", "high").

aoi

Optional sf polygon. When provided, polygons are intersected with it before area weighting.

tfv_col

Character. Column name holding the TFV code. Default "TFV".

mapping

Optional override of the BD Forêt mapping (same columns as bdforet_v2_mapping()).

typology

Optional override of the typology table (same columns as cv_typology()).

Value

A list with:

  • cv: the aggregated CV (numeric fraction).

  • position: the bound used.

  • coverage: total mapped area / total input area (sanity check — how much of the AOI was classified).

  • summary: a per-TFV data.frame (tfv_code, area_ha, context_key, cv, share), sorted by descending area.

  • ambiguous: data.frame of TFV codes where the mapping is flagged ambiguous (the user may want to override via the alt_context_key column).

  • unmapped: TFV codes present in the data but absent from the mapping table.
